question: 统计昨天所有客户产生的告警中，严重和主要告警的总数

question: 找出最近30天内发生过严重告警，并且设备型号为特定型号的所有设备，同时显示其所属客户名称和告警发生次数
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_MODEL, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE e.SEVERITY = 1 AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND n.NE_MODEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_MODEL HAVING alarm_count > 0 ORDER BY alarm_count DESC;

question: 统计本月每个客户产生的每种告警类型的数量，即使某些客户本月没有告警也要显示出来
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS type_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('中国电信上海理想', '测试客户', '南京研发中心', 'ngg-319009', '上海理想公司') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, type_count DESC;

question: 查询上个月告警总数最多的前3个客户，并列出这些客户下所有在线设备的名称和IP地址
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_IP, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS total_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID AND n.IS_ONLINE = 1 WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('中国电信上海理想', '测试客户', '南京研发中心') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_IP ORDER BY total_alarms DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 找出过去三个月内，从未发生过告警的客户，并统计这些客户下激活设备的总数
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(n.CI_ID) AS active_device_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID AND n.IS_ACTIVE = 1 WHERE c.CUSTOMER_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID FROM event_history WHERE EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) AND c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('ngg-319009', '上海理想公司') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING active_device_count > 0;

question: 查询昨天发生告警且告警状态为已恢复的设备，需要显示设备名、客户名、告警类型和告警恢复时间
sql: SELECT n.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, e.RECOVER_TIME FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 AND DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND n.HOST_NAME IN ('cx-sx-cc002', 'tdk-shanghai-b') ORDER BY e.RECOVER_TIME DESC;

question: 统计每个客户在最近7天内，每种告警级别的发生次数，并只显示告警总次数大于5次的客户
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS severity_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY HAVING SUM(COUNT(e.EVENT_ID)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME) > 5 ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY;

question: 找出客户名为中国电信上海理想或南京研发中心，且设备名为cx-sx-cc002或v6-dcs21的所有历史告警记录，按告警发生时间倒序排列
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, e.SEVERITY FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('中国电信上海理想', '南京研发中心') AND n.HOST_NAME IN ('cx-sx-cc002', 'v6-dcs21') ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME DESC;

question: 查询本月告警数量最多的设备，并显示该设备所属的客户信息以及设备的具体型号
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_MODEL, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS month_alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_MODEL ORDER BY month_alarm_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 找出所有告警类型为Trap event或Syslog event，且发生在今天，同时设备处于离线状态的告警详情
sql: SELECT n.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_NAME, e.EVENT_DESC, e.EVENT_TIME FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME IN ('Trap event', 'Syslog event') AND DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) = CURDATE() AND n.IS_ONLINE = 0;

question: 统计过去三个月每个客户下，产生过告警的设备数量与总设备数量的比例
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT n.CI_ID) AS total_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN n.NE_ID END) AS alarmed_devices, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN n.NE_ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT n.CI_ID) * 100, 2) AS alarm_ratio FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 1 GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING total_devices > 0;

question: 查询最近30天内，告警级别为次要或警告，且尚未恢复（状态为活动）的告警，关联显示设备及其客户信息
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, e.EVENT_DESC FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE e.SEVERITY IN (3, 4) AND e.EVENT_STATUS = 1 AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME;

question: 找出上个月平均每天告警次数超过3次的客户，并列出这些客户下所有设备的名称
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID)/DAY(LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))) AS avg_daily_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME HAVING avg_daily_alarms > 3 ORDER BY avg_daily_alarms DESC;

question: 查询设备名为ciscoA或ngg-rt-01的所有历史告警，并按客户分组统计每个客户的告警总数和最近一次告警时间
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS total_alarms, MAX(e.EVENT_TIME) AS last_alarm_time FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE n.HOST_NAME IN ('ciscoA', 'ngg-rt-01') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY total_alarms DESC;

question: 找出最近7天内，同时产生过Ping event和Threshold event两种告警类型的设备，并显示其客户信息
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND n.NE_ID IN (SELECT NE_ID FROM event_history WHERE EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Threshold event') ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME;

question: 统计每个客户在昨天发生的不同告警级别的数量，并以客户名称和告警级别作为行，数量作为列进行展示
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '严重', SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '主要', SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '次要', SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS '警告' FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('中国电信上海理想', '测试客户', '南京研发中心') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME;

question: 查询所有设备创建时间在一年以内，且在过去三个月内产生过严重或主要告警的设备清单，包含客户名
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.CREATE_TIME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS recent_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID AND n.CREATE_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND e.SEVERITY IN (1, 2) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.CREATE_TIME HAVING recent_alarms > 0 ORDER BY recent_alarms DESC;

question: 找出本月告警恢复平均时间最长的前5个设备，并显示其所属客户和平均恢复时间（分钟）
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.EVENT_TIME, e.RECOVER_TIME)) AS avg_recover_minutes FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 AND e.RECOVER_TIME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME ORDER BY avg_recover_minutes DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询客户测试客户名下，所有设备在最近30天内的告警总数，以及这些设备中当前在线的数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.CI_ID) AS total_devices, SUM(CASE WHEN n.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online_devices, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS total_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = '测试客户';

question: 找出过去三个月内，告警发生次数呈月度增长趋势的客户（即每个月的告警数都比上个月多）
sql: WITH monthly_alarms AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(e.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m') AS alarm_month, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, alarm_month) SELECT a1.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM monthly_alarms a1 INNER JOIN monthly_alarms a2 ON a1.CUSTOMER_NAME = a2.CUSTOMER_NAME AND a1.alarm_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(a2.alarm_month, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') WHERE a1.alarm_count > a2.alarm_count GROUP BY a1.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;

question: 查询设备型号相同的设备集合，并统计每个型号在最近7天内产生的告警总数，同时列出拥有该型号设备的一个示例客户
sql: SELECT n.NE_MODEL, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS week_alarms, MAX(c.CUSTOMER_NAME) AS example_customer FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE n.NE_MODEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.NE_MODEL HAVING week_alarms > 0 ORDER BY week_alarms DESC;

question: 找出所有在最近24小时内有新告警产生，且客户联系方式（邮箱或电话）非空的客户，并通知他们
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, c.CUSTOMER_PHONE, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS recent_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) WHERE (c.CUSTOMER_EMAIL IS NOT NULL OR c.CUSTOMER_PHONE IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_EMAIL, c.CUSTOMER_PHONE HAVING recent_alarms > 0;

question: 统计本月每个客户下，处于活动状态的告警数量与已恢复告警数量的比值
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_alarms, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recovered_alarms, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) END AS active_to_recovered_ratio FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING active_alarms > 0 OR recovered_alarms > 0;

question: 查询设备名为demo-switch-01或test-router-02的所有历史告警，并计算从告警发生到恢复的平均时间、最长时间和最短时间
sql: SELECT n.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, e.EVENT_TIME, e.RECOVER_TIME)) AS avg_seconds, MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, e.EVENT_TIME, e.RECOVER_TIME)) AS max_seconds, MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, e.EVENT_TIME, e.RECOVER_TIME)) AS min_seconds FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n INNER JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON n.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE n.HOST_NAME IN ('demo-switch-01', 'test-router-02') AND e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 AND e.RECOVER_TIME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME;

question: 找出上个月告警频率（告警总数/设备数）最高的客户，并列出该客户下所有产生过告警的设备名及告警次数
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS device_alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) WHERE c.CUSTOMER_ID = (SELECT c2.CUSTOMER_ID FROM t_bz_config_customer c2 INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n2 ON c2.CUSTOMER_ID = n2.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e2 ON n2.NE_ID = e2.NE_ID AND YEAR(e2.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(e2.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) GROUP BY c2.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY COUNT(e2.EVENT_ID)/COUNT(DISTINCT n2.CI_ID) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME HAVING device_alarm_count > 0 ORDER BY device_alarm_count DESC;

question: 查询最近30天内，每天产生的告警总数，并关联显示当天产生告警最多的那个客户名称
sql: SELECT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alarm_date, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS daily_total, (SELECT c2.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM t_bz_config_customer c2 INNER JOIN event_history e2 ON c2.CUSTOMER_ID = e2.CUSTOMER_ID AND DATE(e2.EVENT_TIME) = DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) GROUP BY c2.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(e2.EVENT_ID) DESC LIMIT 1) AS top_customer FROM event_history e WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY alarm_date DESC;

question: 查询每个客户在过去30天内至少发生过一次严重告警（SEVERITY='CRITICAL'）的在线设备数量，并按设备数量降序排列
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS online_critical_devices FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.SEVERITY = 'CRITICAL' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY online_critical_devices DESC

question: 找出客户名为'测试客户'或'ngg-319009'的设备中，最近7天内发生'Ping event'告警次数最多的前5台设备（显示设备名、客户名、告警次数）
sql: SELECT r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ping_event_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('测试客户', 'ngg-319009') AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY ping_event_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 查询每个客户在线设备的'Ping event'和'Trap event'告警总数，并计算两种告警的比例（Ping/Trap），仅显示比例大于2的客户
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ping_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trap_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS ping_trap_ratio FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING ping_trap_ratio > 2

question: 找出设备名为'cx-sx-cc002'或'tdk-shanghai-b'的设备，在最近30天内每小时的平均告警数量，并按小时和客户名分组
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS avg_alerts_per_hour FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.HOST_NAME IN ('cx-sx-cc002', 'tdk-shanghai-b') AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, hour_of_day

question: 查询每个客户严重告警（SEVERITY='CRITICAL'）最多的在线设备，显示客户名、设备名、告警次数
sql: WITH ranked_devices AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS critical_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.SEVERITY = 'CRITICAL' GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, critical_count FROM ranked_devices WHERE rn = 1

question: 计算每个客户在过去7天内告警数量的日环比增长率（(今天-昨天)/昨天），仅显示增长率超过50%的客户
sql: WITH daily_counts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alert_date, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)), growth_rates AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, alert_date, alert_count, LAG(alert_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY alert_date) AS prev_count, ROUND((alert_count - LAG(alert_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY alert_date)) / LAG(alert_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY alert_date) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate FROM daily_counts) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, alert_date, alert_count, prev_count, growth_rate FROM growth_rates WHERE growth_rate > 50 AND alert_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

question: 查询每个客户在线设备中，'Ping event'告警持续时间最长的设备（假设连续告警为持续时间），显示客户名、设备名、最大持续天数
sql: WITH ping_events AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, LAG(e.EVENT_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS prev_time FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event'), durations AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, MAX(DATEDIFF(EVENT_TIME, prev_time)) AS max_duration_days FROM ping_events WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, max_duration_days FROM durations WHERE max_duration_days = (SELECT MAX(max_duration_days) FROM durations d2 WHERE d2.CUSTOMER_NAME = durations.CUSTOMER_NAME)

question: 找出每个客户在过去24小时内告警频率最高的设备（告警次数/在线时长），假设在线时长从最早告警时间计算
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS hours_span, ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME)), 0), 2) AS alerts_per_hour FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME ORDER BY alerts_per_hour DESC

question: 查询每个客户不同类型告警（EVENT_TYPE_NAME）的分布比例，并找出'Ping event'占比超过30%的客户
sql: WITH event_totals AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME), customer_totals AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(type_count) AS total_alerts FROM event_totals GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT et.CUSTOMER_NAME, et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, et.type_count, ROUND(et.type_count / ct.total_alerts * 100, 2) AS percentage FROM event_totals et JOIN customer_totals ct ON et.CUSTOMER_ID = ct.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND et.type_count / ct.total_alerts > 0.3

question: 找出每个客户中，同时存在'Ping event'和'Trap event'告警的在线设备数量
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS devices_with_both_events FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME IN ('Ping event', 'Trap event') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' THEN 1 END) > 0

question: 查询每个客户在过去7天内，每小时告警数量的标准差，找出告警最不稳定的客户（标准差最大）
sql: WITH hourly_counts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME)) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, ROUND(STDDEV(alert_count), 2) AS std_deviation FROM hourly_counts GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY std_deviation DESC LIMIT 1

question: 找出每个客户中，告警严重程度（SEVERITY）从低到高升级的设备（例如从WARNING升级到CRITICAL），显示客户名、设备名、升级次数
sql: WITH severity_ranks AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, e.SEVERITY, CASE e.SEVERITY WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 WHEN 'MINOR' THEN 2 WHEN 'MAJOR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 END AS severity_rank, LAG(CASE e.SEVERITY WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 WHEN 'MINOR' THEN 2 WHEN 'MAJOR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 END) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS prev_rank FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS severity_escalations FROM severity_ranks WHERE prev_rank IS NOT NULL AND severity_rank > prev_rank GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

question: 查询每个客户在线设备的平均告警间隔时间（分钟），仅显示间隔时间小于30分钟的客户
sql: WITH time_intervals AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, LAG(e.EVENT_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME), e.EVENT_TIME) AS interval_minutes FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, ROUND(AVG(interval_minutes), 2) AS avg_interval_minutes FROM time_intervals WHERE interval_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING avg_interval_minutes < 30

question: 找出每个客户中，最近3天内告警数量呈上升趋势的设备（每天告警数递增）
sql: WITH daily_device_alerts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alert_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)), trend_check AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, alert_date, daily_count, LAG(daily_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME ORDER BY alert_date) AS prev_count FROM daily_device_alerts) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME FROM trend_check WHERE prev_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN daily_count > prev_count THEN 1 END) = COUNT(*) - 1

question: 查询每个客户在过去30天内，不同严重程度告警的累计数量，并计算CRITICAL告警占比
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'MAJOR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS major_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'MINOR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS minor_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warning_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS critical_percentage FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY critical_percentage DESC

question: 找出每个客户中，'Ping event'告警发生时间最密集的3小时时段（滑动窗口）
sql: WITH hourly_ping_counts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS ping_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME)), window_sums AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, hour, SUM(ping_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY hour ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS three_hour_sum FROM hourly_ping_counts) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, hour AS center_hour, three_hour_sum FROM window_sums WHERE three_hour_sum = (SELECT MAX(three_hour_sum) FROM window_sums ws2 WHERE ws2.CUSTOMER_NAME = window_sums.CUSTOMER_NAME)

question: 查询每个客户在线设备中，最近一次告警时间与当前时间间隔超过24小时的设备数量
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS idle_devices_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT NE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, MAX(EVENT_TIME) AS last_alert FROM event_history GROUP BY NE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID) e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND (e.last_alert IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, e.last_alert, NOW()) > 24) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME

question: 找出每个客户中，告警类型数量最多的设备（显示客户名、设备名、告警类型数）
sql: WITH device_event_types AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME) AS event_type_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, event_type_count FROM device_event_types WHERE event_type_count = (SELECT MAX(event_type_count) FROM device_event_types det2 WHERE det2.CUSTOMER_NAME = device_event_types.CUSTOMER_NAME)

question: 查询每个客户在过去7天内，每小时'Ping event'与'Trap event'告警数量的相关系数（近似计算）
sql: WITH hourly_counts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ping_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trap_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME)) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, ROUND((AVG(ping_count * trap_count) - AVG(ping_count) * AVG(trap_count)) / (STDDEV(ping_count) * STDDEV(trap_count)), 3) AS correlation_coefficient FROM hourly_counts GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING STDDEV(ping_count) > 0 AND STDDEV(trap_count) > 0

question: 找出每个客户中，连续两天都有告警的设备数量
sql: WITH daily_alerts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alert_date FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)), consecutive_days AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, NE_ID, alert_date, LAG(alert_date) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, NE_ID ORDER BY alert_date) AS prev_date FROM daily_alerts) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT NE_ID) AS devices_with_consecutive_alerts FROM consecutive_days WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(alert_date, prev_date) = 1 GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME

question: 查询每个客户在线设备中，告警数量排名前10%的设备（按告警总数）
sql: WITH device_alert_ranks AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_alerts, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS alert_percent_rank FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, total_alerts, ROUND(alert_percent_rank * 100, 2) AS percentile FROM device_alert_ranks WHERE alert_percent_rank <= 0.1 ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME, alert_percent_rank

question: 找出每个客户中，'Ping event'告警平均响应时间最短的设备（假设响应时间为相邻'Trap event'的时间差）
sql: WITH ping_trap_pairs AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME AS ping_time, LEAD(e.EVENT_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS next_trap_time, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME IN ('Ping event', 'Trap event')), response_times AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ping_time, next_trap_time) AS response_seconds FROM ping_trap_pairs WHERE EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND next_trap_time IS NOT NULL) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, ROUND(AVG(response_seconds), 2) AS avg_response_seconds FROM response_times GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME HAVING avg_response_seconds = (SELECT MIN(avg_response_seconds) FROM response_times rt2 WHERE rt2.CUSTOMER_NAME = response_times.CUSTOMER_NAME)

question: 查询每个客户在过去30天内，工作日与周末告警数量的比例（工作日/周末）
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(e.EVENT_TIME) IN (2,3,4,5,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(e.EVENT_TIME) IN (1,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_alerts, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(e.EVENT_TIME) IN (2,3,4,5,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(e.EVENT_TIME) IN (1,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS weekday_weekend_ratio FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING weekend_alerts > 0

question: 找出每个客户中，告警数量月度增长率最高的设备（最近3个月）
sql: WITH monthly_device_alerts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(e.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS monthly_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(e.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m')), growth_rates AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, month, monthly_count, LAG(monthly_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME ORDER BY month) AS prev_count, ROUND((monthly_count - LAG(monthly_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME ORDER BY month)) / LAG(monthly_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME ORDER BY month) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate FROM monthly_device_alerts) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, MAX(growth_rate) AS max_growth_rate FROM growth_rates WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME HAVING max_growth_rate = (SELECT MAX(max_growth_rate) FROM growth_rates gr2 WHERE gr2.CUSTOMER_NAME = growth_rates.CUSTOMER_NAME)

question: 查询每个客户在线设备中，不同严重程度告警的熵值（衡量告警分布的均匀程度）
sql: WITH severity_probabilities AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY, COUNT(*) AS severity_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID) AS probability FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, ROUND(-SUM(probability * LOG2(probability)), 3) AS entropy FROM severity_probabilities GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY entropy DESC

question: 查询每个客户在过去30天内至少发生过一次'Ping event'告警的在线设备数量，并按设备数量降序排列，同时显示客户名称和设备总数。

question: 找出'ngg-319009'客户下，过去7天内'Ping event'告警发生时间间隔最短的设备，显示设备名和平均告警间隔(分钟)。
sql: SELECT r.HOST_NAME, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, prev_time, e.EVENT_TIME)) AS avg_alert_interval_min FROM (SELECT e1.NE_ID, e1.CUSTOMER_ID, e1.EVENT_TIME, (SELECT MAX(e2.EVENT_TIME) FROM event_history e2 WHERE e2.NE_ID = e1.NE_ID AND e2.CUSTOMER_ID = e1.CUSTOMER_ID AND e2.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e2.EVENT_TIME < e1.EVENT_TIME AND e2.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS prev_time FROM event_history e1 WHERE e1.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e1.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS intervals JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON intervals.NE_ID = r.NE_ID AND intervals.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = 'ngg-319009' AND prev_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME ORDER BY avg_alert_interval_min ASC LIMIT 1

question: 找出每个客户下，设备'tdk-shanghai-b'和'cx-sx-cc002'在过去7天内'Trap event'告警数量的对比，显示客户名、设备名和告警数量。

sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS alert_duration_hours FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME HAVING COUNT(e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME) > 1

question: 找出'测试客户'下，过去30天内每天'Ping event'告警数量的变化趋势，并标记出告警数量超过平均值的日期，显示日期、告警数量和是否超过平均值。
sql: SELECT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alert_date, COUNT(*) AS ping_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(daily_count) FROM (SELECT DATE(e2.EVENT_TIME) AS day, COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM event_history e2 JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r2 ON e2.NE_ID = r2.NE_ID AND e2.CUSTOMER_ID = r2.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN t_bz_config_customer c2 ON r2.CUSTOMER_ID = c2.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c2.CUSTOMER_NAME = '测试客户' AND e2.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e2.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(e2.EVENT_TIME)) AS avg_table) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS avg_status FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = '测试客户' AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY alert_date

sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, CASE WHEN r.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Offline' END AS device_status, e.SEVERITY, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, r.IS_ONLINE) AS alert_percentage FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE, e.SEVERITY ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, device_status, e.SEVERITY

question: 查询过去24小时内，每个客户下在线设备中'Trap event'告警的响应时间（从告警发生到当前时间），显示客户名、设备名、告警时间和响应时间(分钟)。

sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN r.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS online_critical_percentage FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' AND e.SEVERITY = 'Critical' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME

question: 找出'ngg-319009'客户下，过去24小时内'Ping event'告警发生时间最密集的时段（每小时），显示时段和告警数量。
sql: SELECT HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alert_hour, COUNT(*) AS ping_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = 'ngg-319009' AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY ping_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: 查询每个客户下，设备'tdk-shanghai-b'在过去7天内'Ping event'告警的持续时间（从首次到最后一次告警）与设备状态的关系，显示客户名、设备状态和平均持续时间(小时)。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, CASE WHEN r.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Offline' END AS device_status, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME))) AS avg_duration_hours FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.HOST_NAME = 'tdk-shanghai-b' AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE HAVING COUNT(e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME) > 1

question: 找出过去30天内，每个客户下'Trap event'告警数量最多的设备及其告警严重级别分布，显示客户名、设备名、严重级别和告警数量。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.SEVERITY, COUNT(*) AS trap_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, e.SEVERITY HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(trap_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS trap_count FROM event_history e2 WHERE e2.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' AND e2.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND e2.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY e2.NE_ID) AS max_counts) ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, trap_count DESC

question: 查询'测试客户'下，过去7天内每天'Ping event'和'Trap event'告警数量的对比，显示日期、Ping告警数、Trap告警数和告警总数。
sql: SELECT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alert_date, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ping_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trap_count, COUNT(*) AS total_alerts FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = '测试客户' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME IN ('Ping event', 'Trap event') GROUP BY DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY alert_date

question: 查询过去30天内，每个客户离线设备（IS_ONLINE=0）产生的严重告警（SEVERITY='CRITICAL'）数量，并按告警数量降序排列，同时显示客户名称和设备总数。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS total_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.IS_ONLINE = 0 AND e.SEVERITY = 'CRITICAL' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN e.NE_ID END) AS critical_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY critical_alarms DESC

question: 找出客户名为'测试客户'且设备名为'tdk-shanghai-b'的设备，在过去7天内产生的'Trap event'告警次数，以及该设备的总告警次数和在线状态。
sql: SELECT r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS total_alarms, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trap_alarms_last_7d FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = '测试客户' AND r.HOST_NAME = 'tdk-shanghai-b' GROUP BY r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE

question: 查询每个客户在线设备（IS_ONLINE=1）中，产生过'Ping event'告警的设备比例，并按比例降序排列。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS online_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN r.NE_ID END) AS ping_alarm_devices, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' THEN r.NE_ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID), 2) AS ping_device_percentage FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY ping_device_percentage DESC

question: 找出过去24小时内，每个客户产生告警最多的前3台设备（按告警次数排名），显示客户名、设备名、告警次数和在线状态。
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS alarm_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) DESC) AS rn FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE) ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME, rn

question: 查询客户'ngg-319009'的所有设备中，哪些设备从未产生过任何告警，并显示这些设备的在线状态。
sql: SELECT r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME = 'ngg-319009' GROUP BY r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE HAVING COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) = 0

question: 统计每个客户在过去30天内，每天产生的不同严重级别（SEVERITY）告警数量，并只显示告警总数大于100的客户。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alarm_date, e.SEVERITY, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME), e.SEVERITY HAVING SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID) > 100 ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, alarm_date DESC

question: 找出同时产生过'Ping event'和'Trap event'告警的设备，并显示其所属客户名称、设备名和在线状态。
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e1 ON r.NE_ID = e1.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e1.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e2 ON r.NE_ID = e2.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e2.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e1.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND e2.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Trap event'

question: 查询每个客户设备告警的月度趋势：计算过去12个月每个月每个客户的告警总数，并计算环比增长率。
sql: WITH monthly_alarms AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(e.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE_FORMAT(e.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m')) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, month, alarm_count, LAG(alarm_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_count, ROUND((alarm_count - LAG(alarm_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(alarm_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS growth_rate FROM monthly_alarms ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME, month DESC

question: 找出设备'cx-sx-cc002'在过去7天内，每小时产生的告警数量分布，并关联显示其客户名称。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.HOST_NAME = 'cx-sx-cc002' AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY hour_of_day

question: 查询每个客户在线和离线设备的平均告警数量，并找出那些离线设备平均告警数高于在线设备的客户。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, AVG(CASE WHEN r.IS_ONLINE = 1 THEN device_alarms.alarm_count END) AS avg_online_alarms, AVG(CASE WHEN r.IS_ONLINE = 0 THEN device_alarms.alarm_count END) AS avg_offline_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT NE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM event_history GROUP BY NE_ID, CUSTOMER_ID) device_alarms ON r.NE_ID = device_alarms.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = device_alarms.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING avg_offline_alarms > avg_online_alarms AND avg_offline_alarms IS NOT NULL

question: 找出过去48小时内告警频率突然增加（当前24小时告警数比前24小时增加50%以上）的设备，显示设备名、客户名和增长率。
sql: WITH hourly_alarms AS (SELECT r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, CASE WHEN e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 'current' WHEN e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR) AND e.EVENT_TIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 'previous' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR) GROUP BY r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, period), period_alarms AS (SELECT NE_ID, HOST_NAME, CUSTOMER_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN alarm_count END) AS current_count, MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'previous' THEN alarm_count END) AS previous_count FROM hourly_alarms GROUP BY NE_ID, HOST_NAME, CUSTOMER_NAME) SELECT HOST_NAME, CUSTOMER_NAME, current_count, previous_count, ROUND((current_count - previous_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous_count, 0), 2) AS growth_rate FROM period_alarms WHERE current_count > previous_count * 1.5 ORDER BY growth_rate DESC

question: 查询每个客户的不同告警类型（EVENT_TYPE_NAME）分布，并计算每种告警类型在客户总告警数中的占比，按客户和占比降序排列。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS type_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID) AS percentage FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, percentage DESC

question: 找出过去30天内，每天告警数都超过10条的设备，并显示其客户名称和在线状态。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS days_with_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, r.IS_ONLINE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) = 30 AND MIN(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) > 10

question: 查询每个客户设备中最常出现的告警类型（按告警次数排名前3），并显示该类型告警次数和设备总数。
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS affected_devices, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME) ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME, rn

question: 找出过去7天内，告警总数超过其历史平均日告警数2倍以上的设备，显示设备名、客户名和比率。
sql: WITH device_stats AS (SELECT r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_alarms, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS days_with_alarms, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS avg_daily_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME), recent_alarms AS (SELECT r.NE_ID, COUNT(*) AS recent_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY r.NE_ID) SELECT s.HOST_NAME, s.CUSTOMER_NAME, s.avg_daily_alarms, r.recent_count / 7 AS recent_daily_avg, (r.recent_count / 7) / s.avg_daily_alarms AS ratio FROM device_stats s JOIN recent_alarms r ON s.NE_ID = r.NE_ID WHERE (r.recent_count / 7) > s.avg_daily_alarms * 2 ORDER BY ratio DESC

question: 查询每个客户在过去24小时内，不同严重级别（SEVERITY）告警的设备覆盖率（产生该级别告警的设备数/总设备数）。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY, COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) AS affected_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT r2.NE_ID) AS total_devices, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.NE_ID) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r2.NE_ID), 2) AS coverage_percentage FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r2 ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r2.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.SEVERITY ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, coverage_percentage DESC

question: 找出过去30天内，连续3天以上每天都有告警产生的设备，并显示其客户名称和连续天数。
sql: WITH daily_alarms AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alarm_date, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)), consecutive_groups AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, alarm_date, DATE_SUB(alarm_date, INTERVAL ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME ORDER BY alarm_date) DAY) AS grp FROM daily_alarms) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_days, MIN(alarm_date) AS start_date, MAX(alarm_date) AS end_date FROM consecutive_groups GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY consecutive_days DESC

question: 查询每个客户设备中，产生告警最多的前10%的设备（按告警总数排名），显示客户名、设备名和告警数。
sql: WITH device_rank AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS total_alarms, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) DESC) AS pct_rank FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, total_alarms FROM device_rank WHERE pct_rank <= 0.1 ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME, total_alarms DESC

question: 找出过去7天内，每小时告警数超过该小时平均告警数2倍的时间段，并关联显示该时间段内告警最多的客户。
sql: WITH hourly_stats AS (SELECT HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS total_alarms, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS avg_hourly_alarms FROM event_history e WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME)), hourly_customer_alarms AS (SELECT HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour_of_day, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS customer_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME), c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME) SELECT h.hour_of_day, h.avg_hourly_alarms, hc.CUSTOMER_NAME, hc.customer_alarms FROM hourly_stats h JOIN hourly_customer_alarms hc ON h.hour_of_day = hc.hour_of_day WHERE hc.customer_alarms > h.avg_hourly_alarms * 2 ORDER BY h.hour_of_day, hc.customer_alarms DESC

question: 查询每个客户在过去30天内，告警数量的标准差，以评估告警的波动性，并列出波动性最大的前5个客户。
sql: WITH daily_customer_alarms AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alarm_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(*) AS days_with_data, AVG(daily_alarms) AS avg_daily_alarms, STDDEV(daily_alarms) AS std_deviation FROM daily_customer_alarms GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY std_deviation DESC LIMIT 5

question: 找出过去24小时内，告警频率（每分钟告警数）超过其历史平均频率3倍以上的设备，显示设备名、客户名和当前频率。
sql: WITH device_avg_frequency AS (SELECT r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(*) / (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME)) + 1) AS avg_freq FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, c.CUSTOMER_NAME), recent_frequency AS (SELECT r.NE_ID, COUNT(*) / 1440.0 AS recent_freq FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY r.NE_ID) SELECT d.HOST_NAME, d.CUSTOMER_NAME, d.avg_freq, r.recent_freq, r.recent_freq / d.avg_freq AS ratio FROM device_avg_frequency d JOIN recent_frequency r ON d.NE_ID = r.NE_ID WHERE r.recent_freq > d.avg_freq * 3 ORDER BY ratio DESC

question: 查询每个客户在过去7天内，不同告警类型（EVENT_TYPE_NAME）的首次和最后一次出现时间，以及该类型告警的总次数。
sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME) AS first_occurrence, MAX(e.EVENT_TIME) AS last_occurrence, COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, total_occurrences DESC

question: 找出过去30天内，每天告警数都排在前3的设备（按客户分组），显示设备名、客户名和排名天数。
sql: WITH daily_rank AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) AS alarm_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_alarms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS daily_rank FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, DATE(e.EVENT_TIME)) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS top3_days FROM daily_rank WHERE daily_rank <= 3 GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = 30 ORDER BY top3_days DESC

question: 查询每个客户设备中，告警严重级别（SEVERITY）的升级模式：统计从低级别升级到高级别的告警序列数量。
sql: WITH severity_sequences AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, e.SEVERITY, LAG(e.SEVERITY) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS prev_severity, CASE WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'CRITICAL' AND LAG(e.SEVERITY) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) IN ('WARNING', 'MINOR', 'MAJOR') THEN 1 WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'MAJOR' AND LAG(e.SEVERITY) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) IN ('WARNING', 'MINOR') THEN 1 WHEN e.SEVERITY = 'MINOR' AND LAG(e.SEVERITY) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) = 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severity_upgrade FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS upgrade_count FROM severity_sequences WHERE severity_upgrade = 1 GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME ORDER BY upgrade_count DESC

question: 找出过去7天内，告警产生的时间间隔（分钟）小于5分钟的频繁告警设备对（同一客户下的两个设备），显示客户名、设备对和平均间隔。
sql: WITH device_alarms AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, LAG(e.EVENT_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS prev_time FROM t_bz_config_customer c JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = r.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)), close_alarms AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, NE_ID, HOST_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, prev_time, EVENT_TIME) AS time_gap FROM device_alarms WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, prev_time, EVENT_TIME) < 5), frequent_devices AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, NE_ID, HOST_NAME, AVG(time_gap) AS avg_gap, COUNT(*) AS close_alarm_count FROM close_alarms GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, NE_ID, HOST_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, GROUP_CONCAT(HOST_NAME ORDER BY HOST_NAME) AS device_pair, COUNT(*) AS device_count, AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM frequent_devices GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY overall_avg_gap
